correctness.rationale: The pure adjacency sunlet S_n=C_n∘K1 for n≥3 has 2n vertices, and corona preserves four-round EF equivalence by mirroring the selected rim/leaf side and playing the base-cycle game on coordinates. The proof handles repeated selections and same-coordinate different-side vertices via equality. Brown–Hoshino 2007 Theorem 4.9 establishes C_n≡4C_m for all n,m≥11, giving infinite tail with no extrapolation. An exact rank-four nested-type recursion on ordered tuples, quotienting by valid dihedral automorphisms, independently reproduced rank-type counts 116,122,46,14,8 and the classes {3},...,{9},{10,11,12,13,14,15}. The bridge S10≡4S11 and transitivity gives n≥10. Sharp family-relative smallest maximum 20 vertices follows as S10 has no equivalent smaller S_n. Direct tuple-based source implementation was separately inspected.
